Wait "use that result to find the highest common factor with another pair of numbers (90,120)" Means compute HCF of 15 and 90? Or HCF of 15 and 120? Or HCF of 15 and (90,120)? Likely they want HCF of 15 and 90, then HCF of that result with 120? But ambiguous.

Better interpret: After computing HCF(45,60)=15, then compute HCF(15,90,120). But HCF of three numbers: HCF(15,90,120) = HCF(HCF(15,90),120). HCF(15,90)=15. Then HCF(15,120)=15. So result 15.

Alternatively maybe they want HCF(15,90)=15, then HCF(15,120)=15. So same.

Similarly second part: HCF(36,48)=12. Then HCF(12,72,96). HCF(12,72)=12, HCF(12,96)=12. So result 12.

Thus answer: 15 and 12.
